content: Imseyyaren iɛeffanen n Urcalim
“Maɣar xzar, Sidi, SIDI n řɛeskarat, ad ikkes x Urcalim d Yahuda qaɛ aɛekkaz d qaɛ taɣɣarct, qaɛ tamewciwt s ufus n weɣrum d qaɛ tamewciwt s ufus n waman,
bu-teɣruḍt d uɛeskari, řqaḍi d unabi, agezzan d umɣar,
ameqqran x xemsin d bu-ccan, amcawar, bu-ṣṣenɛet d wenni ɣar iǧa řefhamet n tḥessect n uɛezzem.
Necc ad xasen ggeɣ iḥuḍriyyen d řḥukkam nsen u nitni ad xasen sellṭen am mammec ttexsen nitni.
Xenni di řgens ad ḥsaren ijj i wenneɣni, aryaz i weryaz nneɣni, kuř ijj i jjar nnes. Nitni ad hekkweřen ijj i wenneɣni, aḥudri i uwessar, wenni ittwasseḥqaren i wenni ittwacennɛen.
Xmi ɣa icebbar ca n yijjen umas di taddart n babas, ad yini: ‘Cek ɣarek ɛad ijj n upartessu, ittxeṣṣa ad tiřid d amgewwed xaneɣ. Arr řxarbet-a sadu afus nnec!’,
xenni ad yagi netta deg wass nni, ad yini: ‘Necc war zemmareɣ ad iřiɣ d amesgenfu. War din bu weɣrum u war din bu warruḍ di taddart inu. War d ayi teggem d amgewwed n řgens!’
Maɣar tennedref tendint n Urcalim u tewḍa Yahuda, minzi iřes nsen d tmegga nsen aqa aten ḍidd i SIDI maḥend ad sɛaren tiṭṭawin n uɛuǧi nnes.
Tifras n iɣembab nsen cehhdent xasen. Am Sadum ssawařen nitni s bṭayṭay x ddnub nsen, war ten ssnuffaren. Uct x řeɛmar nsen, maɣar nitni tteggen řɣar deg yixef nsen.”
“Inim i umsegged aqa ad yiři mliḥ, aqa ad ccen s yixef nsen řɣiǧet n tmegga nsen.
Uct x uɛeffan. Uct xas, maɣar ad t xeǧṣen ɛlaḥsab min ggin ifassen nnes.
Inni ideǧen řgens inu aqa aten d iḥenjiren, uca timɣarin ttṣellṭent xas. A řgens inu, inni cek ineddhen, aqa ttɣarran cek, uca řatar n tbridin nnec messḥen t.”
“SIDI iwjed ḥima ad icarreɛ, Netta ibedd ḥima ad icarreɛ řegnus.
SIDI ad dd-yarfeɛ ddeɛwet ak-d imɣaren n řgens u ak-d řḥukkam nnes, maɣar kenniw tesscemḍem amarjeɛ n uḍiř u min tucarem i imezřaḍ aqa-t di tudrin nwem.
Min kenniw yuɣin, aqa třebbzem řgens inu u tᵉtteffẓem iɣembab n imezřaḍ?, iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI n řɛeskarat.”
Timɣarin timɛeffarin n Urcalim
Ammu i iqqar SIDI: “Minzi yessis n Ṣihyun daysent nnfaxet, ggurent s irawen geɛɛden, s řexzrat ttɣarrant, am ttraḥent u ttqezqizent s iṣuraf maḥend ad ssṭenṭunent ixeřxařen n iḍaren nsent,
ad yarr Sidi inu jdam x taceqquft n uzeǧif n yessis n Ṣihyun uca ad iɛarra SIDI řɛar nsent.”
“Deg wass nni ad asent ikkes Sidi inu marra řehzuṭ nsent: ixeřxařen x iḍaren nsent d řizarat ttwaceddent x tenyart d tezriwin timeẓyanin
d texrazin di ṣṣifet n tuddimin d timeqyasin d lltamat
d iḥewwaqen izewwqen i uzeǧif d ixerxařen d tḥezzamin d tziyyatin ittfuḥen d řeḥruz
d txadin n ufus d texrazin n tenzarin
d warruḍ n weydud d řizarat d tsebnay d iqurab
d tisitin d werruḍ n řeqṭen azdad d tcuccay d funarat n uzeǧif.

Deg wemcan n řefwaḥet n balsam ad tiři arriḥet, deg wemcam n tḥezzamt ad yiři wesɣun, deg wemcan n tcenkukin icuwwaren ad yiři uzeǧif aqeccar, deg wemcan n werruḍ iwseɛ ad tiři txancet n wecḍan u deg wemcan n weẓri d uɛeǧem n wecmaḍ x teřmect.
Iryazen nnem ad wḍan s ssif u ayt n bu-teɣruḍt nnem deg umenɣi.
Tiwwura nnes ad cetcant u ad ceḍnent uca nettat ad teqqim x temmurt s ifassen xwan.”

footnotes.text: Arr řxarbet-a ...- s Tɛibranit ‘Ḥḍa x řxarbet-a sadu ifassen nnec’
Tiwwura nnes- ixs ad yini ‘tiwwura n Urcalim’ niɣ ‘tiwwura n Ṣihyun’.
